UPLOAD SERVICE — TEST OBSERVATIONS
Document: test-observations.txt
Test run: DEMO-RUN-2026-10-27
Environment: Staging
Status: Partial manual test notes; not a complete acceptance report
Purpose: Synthetic companion source for the RealityCheck demo.

OBS-001 — Valid TXT upload
A 2 KB .txt file was accepted. The API returned HTTP 202 and a job identifier. Job status reached completed. This test was run once.

OBS-002 — Valid PDF upload
A small text-based PDF was accepted and reached completed. No scanned-PDF fixture was included in this run.

OBS-003 — Unsupported extension
A .csv upload returned HTTP 400. The response included a validation message. No job identifier was observed in the response.

OBS-004 — Upload size boundary
A 52 MB test file was rejected by the staging upload route before extraction. The test did not try a file between 50 MB and 80 MB, so it does not establish the exact boundary in production.

OBS-005 — Processing timeout
No slow-extraction fixture was run. The 45-second acceptance criterion remains unverified by this observation set.

OBS-006 — Log redaction
The log review used a synthetic API key. The key was not found in the sampled application log lines. Authorization-header coverage and document-body logging were not tested.

OBS-007 — Evidence traceability
A reviewer opened one candidate finding and reached a source document. The reviewer did not record a line-by-line check that the displayed excerpt was the exact supporting evidence.

OBS-008 — Offline provider disclosure
The staging UI displayed an “Offline demo — simulated analysis” label during this run.

OBS-009 — Retention cleanup
No retention cleanup execution was observed during this test run. The configured retention duration remains unverified by runtime observation.

IMPORTANT
Observations describe only the specific tests performed. A missing test is not a failed test, and a single successful test does not prove all cases are correct.
